summary: Extend TemporalReportedProblems to surface repeated activity retry failures with low-cardinality tokens, enabling operators to detect stuck activities without inspecting individual workflow history.
userImpact: Operators gain improved visibility into repeated activity retry failures, enabling faster detection and diagnosis of stuck executions without manual history inspection.
proposedFix: Add namespace dynamic config threshold for consecutive activity task problems; upsert bounded, low-cardinality tokens (category=ActivityTaskFailed/ActivityTaskTimedOut, cause=ApplicationFailure/ActivityTaskTimedOutCauseStartToClose) into TemporalReportedProblems; clear signal when activity succeeds, is canceled, or reset; derive from mutable/history state rather than storing raw error messages.
keyQuote: Activity retry loops can create a similar operational state: an execution is still alive, but one or more activities are repeatedly failing or timing out and the workflow is not making useful progress.
